question: Describe fixed-token performance of the two pinned CPU backends on this Mac with Docker temporarily stopped during one declared work period.
prior_information: The excluded strict setup, earlier quality and diagnostic observations, all four desktop-v2 setup observations, and nine successful desktop-v2 measured invocations were seen. V2 produced four complete KleidiAI-first pairs, one per workload. Their CPU/KleidiAI mean-duration ratios were 1.604607670455332 (pp512), 1.4780643779681868 (pp2048), 0.7681896574945443 (tg128-d512) and 0.6921666247909088 (tg128-d2048). V2 stopped on memory pressure after the ninth run. The owner confirmed updating Docker during that run and authorized stopping the updated stack for this new study. This is a prospective repeat with known prior outcomes; settings, gates, schedule, formula and analysis are unchanged. All four desktop-v3 setup observations and all 48 measured invocations / 24 pair ratios were also seen. V3 completed its old boundary checks, but power logs confirmed sleep during three processes. Its native and parent clocks counted sleep differently. The full unchanged report and clock audit remain public. V4 changes only timing protection and its evidence requirements: owned idle-sleep prevention, suspend-aware deadlines, clock continuity and verified checkpoint transfer. Known prior outcomes do not justify selecting or dropping rows. No prior observations enter V4 estimates.

host_condition.docker: temporarily stop the newly recorded updated Docker stack through the authorized graceful shutdown; restore and verify that current stack after completion, failure or interruption, preserving any initially exited containers
host_condition.background: Other user and system activity may continue. No other benchmark, build, model or test jobs during fresh setup or measured sessions.
host_condition.scope: This observed work period with Docker stopped is not representative of ordinary Docker-running use or all desktop use.
required_before_launch: frozen power mode and host identity
matching thermal availability and any reported limits

setup.eligibility: Complete native contract and resource report, unchanged inputs, successful closed timing evidence and no effective host stop. Swap increases alone are recorded and do not exclude.
setup.failure: Retain the attempt and stop setup. No retry, replacement or partial calibration.
setup.measured_deadline_rule: max(600, ceil(2 * longest eligible suspend-inclusive process wall seconds / 60) * 60)

measurement.session_spacing: Consecutive blocks within one work period; not independent replications.
measurement.assignment: Balanced adjacent CPU/KleidiAI pairs with shuffled workload order. The frozen seed places KleidiAI first in round 1 and CPU first in round 2; backend order is therefore linked to round, which limits causal interpretation.
measurement.native_settings: Unchanged from the reviewed normal fixed-token workloads.

host_rule.swap_activity: Record every increase; no threshold, filtering or timing adjustment.
host_rule.other_departure: Stop future launches on missing/reset telemetry, AC/mode/pressure/thermal/identity changes. Retain completed valid observations with flags. Stop after failed timing continuity, sleep assertion or cleanup.
host_rule.protocol_completion: False after any effective host, timing, integrity or cleanup failure, even if all planned ratios exist.
host_rule.telemetry: Boundary host readings and setup child resource report only. No new native instrumentation or process counter observer.

analysis.pair_inclusion: Both processes completed with valid native data, within the suspend-aware deadline and with verified inputs. Preserve mechanical ratios and flags according to the current reporter, but never present a timing-invalid pair as clean performance evidence. Incomplete or invalid native pairs have no ratio.
analysis.process_duration: Arithmetic mean of the three designated measured durations.
analysis.ratio: CPU mean duration divided by KleidiAI mean duration.
analysis.report: All raw repetitions, all pair ratios, order, session median/range, host findings and all 48 planned outcomes.
analysis.sample_size: A fixed resource budget, not a power calculation.
limits: Completion-conditioned descriptive ratios, with every failure retained.
No significance test, population confidence interval, tail-latency estimate or universal Arm64 speedup.
Pairing and random order do not prove isolation or remove systematic bias.
Synthetic compute excludes retrieval, tokenization, sampling, prefix setup, state restoration and model loading.
KleidiAI quality and adoption remain rejected.
This is a prospective local repeat with known earlier outcomes, not a blinded study or external preregistration.
No clean performance claim if the timing guard fails. Retain the full planned denominator and all failures without post-hoc exclusions or timing corrections.

supersedes.reason: Sleep affected three V3 processes. Preserve V3 unchanged and collect fresh guarded observations; do not pool studies, replace selected rows or subtract sleep.

timing.scope: Guard setup observations, native waits, host probes, verification, rests and measured sessions. Verify continuity between setup observations and between measured sessions. Setup and the measured study are separate phases; no timing estimate spans their review gap.
timing.failure: Preserve the first failure and all raw output. Stop later launches after a guard, host, integrity or cleanup failure. No retry or replacement. A deadline expiry is a failed native attempt even if exit zero is observed after the deadline.
limits: Idle-sleep prevention does not block every possible suspend or OS interruption.
Clock readings are bracketed and have the declared uncertainty allowance; sub-threshold interruptions may not be detected.
Cleanup after suspend occurs on the next scheduled check after wake, not while the machine is suspended.
An elapsed-time validity check is not proof of CPU isolation or fixed thermal conditions.
